name: Ollama
tagline: Get up and running with large language models.
description: Ollama is the largest developer platform for open models. It lets developers download, run, and manage large language models locally on their own machines or servers via CLI, API, and cloud scaling, used to build chatbots, coding assistants, and AI agents. The platform serves 8.9 million monthly active developers with 67,000+ community-built integrations and is used within 85% of the Fortune 500.
